title: Piano Movers in Burbank | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Piano movers in Burbank for foothill steps north of Glenoaks and the rest of the house: four movers on one hourly job and a $200 piano add-on.
heroSubtitle: A crew of four, a padded board and tie-down straps for the upright or grand in your Burbank home, whether it sits on a foothill lot or a level street.

faq.question: My Burbank house sits above the street with outdoor steps. Can you still move the piano?
faq.answer: Yes. Stairs change the pace of the job, not whether it happens: four movers carry the piano on a padded board and pause at each landing. Send photos of every flight when you book, and the office will build the steps into the time estimate.

faq.question: How does the crew get through the guard gate at Burbank Hills?
faq.answer: Add the crew and the truck to the gate list the day before and pass along the arrival window we confirm. Should the HOA require a Certificate of Insurance, ours costs $50 and goes to the association before move day. Check with the association about allowed moving hours as well.

faq.question: Is the piano billed separately from the rest of my move?
faq.answer: No. The piano adds a flat $200 to an hourly move with four movers, and the 3-hour minimum is counted across everything we move that day. Four movers with a truck cost $199 cash or $209 card per hour Monday to Thursday, and $215 or $225 from Friday to Sunday.

faq.question: Can a piano move in Burbank happen on the day I call?
faq.answer: Often it can, provided a four-person crew has an opening. Ring 909-443-0004 early in the morning: crews start at 8AM and wrap up by 6PM, seven days a week, so the whole job has to fit between those times.

faq.question: Will you set up my grand piano again and tune it?
faq.answer: The crew reattaches the legs, pedal lyre and lid in the room you choose, since a grand travels on its straight side with those parts removed. Tuning is not something SOS offers, so arrange a tuner once the piano has had a while to settle in its new room.
